what: Kezdőlap — edzésnap: Friday 9 October 2026, the plan's "Felsőtest – húzás" day, no session started yet (the approved Home frame).
why: The seed always leaves user@ mid-session and today's plan day is decided by the SERVER clock, so this state cannot be reached without ending the session (a write) on a Friday.
how: The page clock of the state is the frame's day (pulse-frames.json, "clock"), so the week strip asks for the week of 5 October and the header prints the Friday. The session is taken away, and today's row is rewritten into the Friday row of the same plan: its values are the ones the recorded week (GET /my-plans/week?from=2026-10-05, row 4) carries for that day.
